data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage defense and security company led by experienced operators from Anduril, Aerojet Rocketdyne, and Blue Origin. The valuation exercise triangulates across a peer set of 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector, including direct-stage match UFORCE and Series A peers Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, with valuations ranging $125M to $4.0B.

Two methods inform the analysis. Stage-progression applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $12M total raised, yielding $30M, reflecting typical risk and capital progression from Seed to next stage. Peer-median anchors to the $1.0B valuation of the five-company comparison set, representing observed market pricing for Defense & Security at this and adjacent stages.

The triangulated range spans $26M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $515M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around the company's technology readiness, market addressability, and near-term revenue trajectory relative to peers. The upper bound derives principally from peer-median methodology; the lower bound from stage-progression alone. Resolution of this range depends on customer validation, technical differentiation, and clarity on go-to-market timing and scale potential.
